title: Phenol-free RNA extraction of Rubus armeniacus berries
author: Katharina Wolff

steps.title: Prepare reaction tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare two 2 mL reaction tubes per berry containing 900 µL of Extraction Buffer (ensure buffer is mixed as PVPP is insoluble) supplemented with 2% β-mercaptoethanol.

steps.title: Homogenize berry sample
steps.instruction: Homogenize one frozen berry using a mortar and pestle in liquid N2 until it becomes a powder.

steps.title: Resuspend sample in buffer
steps.instruction: Add the homogenized berry powder to the two preheated extraction buffer tubes and resuspend carefully, avoiding the transfer of ice.

steps.title: Incubate and mix
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples at 65 °C for 20 minutes, inverting the tubes frequently to mix the solution.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 11,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: First chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to fresh 2 mL reaction tubes and perform the first chloroform extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Chloroform:Isoamylalcohol (24:1)
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C

steps.title: Second chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper phase into a fresh tube and repeat the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Chloroform:Isoamylalcohol (24:1)
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C

steps.title: RNA precipitation with LiCl
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper phase to a clean 1.5 mL reaction tube and precipitate the RNA.

steps.title: Wash RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet with 500 µL of ice-cold 70% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C

steps.title: Pellet the RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples at 12,000 x g for 20 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dissolve RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Decant the ethanol and dissolve the RNA pellet in 100 µL TE buffer.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA by adding 300 µL of ice-cold absolute ethanol and gently mixing by inversion.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C

steps.title: Final dissolution and storage
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and dissolve the RNA pellet in 20 µL of TE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Perform quality checks using NanoDrop measurements and gel electrophoresis
